title: Homelab · Host Focus
description: Managed in Ansible. Host names are inventory identities, independent of IP or Swarm placement. Empty panels mean the exporter has not reported that metric; they do not imply a healthy zero.

options.content: Every resource panel follows the selected host. CPU/RAM prefer its mapped Proxmox guest accounting; thread IDs are reported OS logical CPUs, not physical cores or allocated LXC capacity. Physical sensors require declared capability; attached GPU ownership is explicit. Unavailable means unsupported/unreported.

panels.title: CPU utilization
panels.description: Mapped Proxmox guests use authoritative PVE guest CPU usage; physical/unmapped hosts use native OS counters.

targets.expr: (100 * max by(guest_id)(label_replace(pve_cpu_usage_ratio{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"},"guest_id","$1","id","(.*)")) * on(guest_id) group_right() max by(host,guest_id,kind)(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host="$host",guest_id!=""})) or on(host) (100 * (1 - avg by(host) (max by(host,cpu)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle",host="$host"}[$__rate_interval])))))

panels.title: RAM use
panels.description: OS used RAM = 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal when available (including correctly virtualized LXC memory). Only hosts without OS metrics, such as HA, fall back to PVE residency/configured RAM. Residency is separately shown below and is not guest memory pressure.

targets.expr: label_replace((100 * (1 - max by(host)(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node",host="$host"}) / max by(host)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node",host="$host"}))),"memory_source","OS used","host",".*") or on(host) label_replace((100 * max by(guest_id)(label_replace(pve_memory_usage_bytes{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"},"guest_id","$1","id","(.*)")) / max by(guest_id)(label_replace(pve_memory_size_bytes{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"},"guest_id","$1","id","(.*)")) * on(guest_id) group_right() max by(host,guest_id,kind)(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host="$host",guest_id!=""})),"memory_source","PVE residency","host",".*")

panels.title: Load / reported logical CPU
panels.description: LXC per-thread /proc CPU counters belong to the parent and are intentionally excluded. Total guest CPU uses authoritative Proxmox accounting.

targets.expr: max by(host) (node_load1{host="$host",job="node"}) / count by(host) (max by(host,cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{host="$host",job="node",mode="idle"})) and on(host) max by(host)(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host="$host",kind!="lxc"})
max by(host,kind)(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host="$host"})

panels.title: Logical CPU / SMT thread IDs · numeric order
panels.description: LXC per-thread /proc CPU counters belong to the parent and are intentionally excluded. Total guest CPU uses authoritative Proxmox accounting.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(sort_desc(100 * (1 - max by(host,cpu)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle",host="$host"}[$__rate_interval])))) and on(host) max by(host)(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host="$host",kind!="lxc"}),"thread_id","$1","cpu","(.*)"),"thread_id","0$1","cpu","([0-9])")

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Same authoritative guest/native fallback as the CPU gauge; excludes misleading parent-visible LXC counters when PVE guest accounting exists.

targets.expr: (100 * max by(guest_id)(label_replace(pve_cpu_usage_ratio{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"},"guest_id","$1","id","(.*)")) * on(guest_id) group_right() max by(host,guest_id,kind)(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host="$host",guest_id!=""})) or on(host) (100 * (1 - avg by(host) (max by(host,cpu)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle",host="$host"}[$__rate_interval])))))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Prefer actual OS used RAM (MemTotal minus MemAvailable); only fall back to PVE resident accounting when OS counters are unavailable.

targets.expr: label_replace((max by(host) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{host="$host",job="node"}) - max by(host) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{host="$host",job="node"})),"memory_source","OS used","host",".*") or on(host) label_replace((max by(guest_id)(label_replace(pve_memory_usage_bytes{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"},"guest_id","$1","id","(.*)")) * on(guest_id) group_right() max by(host,guest_id,kind)(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host="$host",guest_id!=""})),"memory_source","PVE residency","host",".*")

panels.title: Filesystem available
panels.description: Local disks only; network shares and temporary mounts are excluded.

targets.expr: max by(host,mountpoint) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{host="$host",job="node",fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs|vfat|f2fs|ntfs|exfat",mountpoint!~"/(dev|proc|sys|run|var/lib/docker|var/lib/containers|var/lib/kubelet)(/.*)?"})

sum by(host,device) (max by(host,device) (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{host="$host",job="node",device!~"loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval])) + max by(host,device) (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{host="$host",job="node",device!~"loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
max by(host,device) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{host="$host",job="node",device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*|fwbr.*|fwpr.*|fwln.*|tap.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
max by(host,device) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{host="$host",job="node",device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*|fwbr.*|fwpr.*|fwln.*|tap.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Physical temperature sensors
panels.description: Maximum actual sensor reading within each explicitly physical chip; individual sensor identities are shown on CPU/GPU Capacity. Inherited LXC readings excluded. Invalid sensor sentinels outside -20..150°C are excluded; missing readings stay unavailable.

targets.expr: max by(host,chip,sensor)(((node_hwmon_temp_celsius{job="node",host="$host"} > -20) < 150)) * on(host) group_left() max by(host)(node_monitoring_capability_info{job="node",capability="temperature",mode="physical",host="$host"})

panels.title: SMART quick health
panels.description: Physical drives only; see Disk health for detail.

targets.expr: max by(host,device)(smartctl_device_smart_status{job="smartctl",host="$host"}) * on(host) group_left() max by(host)(node_monitoring_capability_info{job="node",capability="smart",mode="physical"})

panels.title: ZFS ARC size
panels.description: Cache is included in kernel used-memory reporting. Display its actual size separately; do not infer application memory by subtracting an estimate.

targets.expr: max by(host) (node_zfs_arc_size{host="$host",job="node",host!~"ct[0-9]+"})

panels.title: Guest running state
panels.description: Guest ID filter is independent of the Host filter; templates are excluded. Cluster views are deduplicated by guest ID.

targets.expr: (max by(id) (pve_up{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"}) * on(id) group_left(name,node,type) topk by(id) (1, max by(id,name,node,type) (pve_guest_info{job="pve",template="0",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"}))) * on(id) group_left(host) max by(id,host)(label_replace(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host="$host",guest_id!=""},"id","$1","guest_id","(.*)"))

panels.title: Guest CPU utilization
panels.description: Proxmox guest CPU ratio. Both exporter cluster views deduplicate by ID.

targets.expr: (100 * max by(id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"}) * on(id) group_left(name,node,type) topk by(id) (1, max by(id,name,node,type) (pve_guest_info{job="pve",template="0",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"}))) * on(id) group_left(host) max by(id,host)(label_replace(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host="$host",guest_id!=""},"id","$1","guest_id","(.*)"))

panels.title: PVE resident RAM / configured
panels.description: Proxmox-reported memory usage relative to configured memory. QEMU reporting may include guest cache or balloon accounting.

targets.expr: (100 * (max by(id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"}) / max by(id) (pve_memory_size_bytes{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"})) * on(id) group_left(name,node,type) topk by(id) (1, max by(id,name,node,type) (pve_guest_info{job="pve",template="0",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"}))) * on(id) group_left(host) max by(id,host)(label_replace(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host="$host",guest_id!=""},"id","$1","guest_id","(.*)"))

panels.title: LXC root filesystem used
panels.description: LXC root filesystem reporting from Proxmox. VM disk usage is omitted because QEMU does not supply guest filesystem usage here.

targets.expr: (100 * (max by(id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+",id=~"lxc/.+"}) / max by(id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+",id=~"lxc/.+"})) * on(id) group_left(name,node,type) topk by(id) (1, max by(id,name,node,type) (pve_guest_info{job="pve",template="0",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"}))) * on(id) group_left(host) max by(id,host)(label_replace(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host="$host",guest_id!=""},"id","$1","guest_id","(.*)"))
max by(host,ups) (network_ups_tools_battery_charge{host="$host",job="nut"})
max by(host,ups) (network_ups_tools_battery_runtime{host="$host",job="nut"})
max by(host,ups) (network_ups_tools_ups_load{host="$host",job="nut"})

panels.title: UPS online power flag
panels.description: Online flag only. No data means the exporter did not report status; zero does not by itself identify the cause.

targets.expr: max by(host,ups) (network_ups_tools_ups_status{host="$host",job="nut",flag="OL"})

panels.title: Selected host · attached GPU telemetry (support varies)

targets.expr: (max by(host)(igpu_rcs0_busy_pct{job="node"}) * on(host) group_left(physical_host,physical_device) max by(host,physical_host,physical_device)(node_monitoring_gpu_owner_info{job="node",gpu_kind="igpu",mode="passthrough",host="$host"} or node_monitoring_gpu_owner_info{job="node",gpu_kind="igpu",mode="passthrough",physical_host="$host"})) and on(host) ((time() - max by(host)(igpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node"})) < 180)

(max by(host)(igpu_vcs0_busy_pct{job="node"}) * on(host) group_left(physical_host,physical_device) max by(host,physical_host,physical_device)(node_monitoring_gpu_owner_info{job="node",gpu_kind="igpu",mode="passthrough",host="$host"} or node_monitoring_gpu_owner_info{job="node",gpu_kind="igpu",mode="passthrough",physical_host="$host"})) and on(host) ((time() - max by(host)(igpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node"})) < 180)

(1e6 * (max by(host)(igpu_actual_freq_mhz{job="node"}) * on(host) group_left(physical_host,physical_device) max by(host,physical_host,physical_device)(node_monitoring_gpu_owner_info{job="node",gpu_kind="igpu",mode="passthrough",host="$host"} or node_monitoring_gpu_owner_info{job="node",gpu_kind="igpu",mode="passthrough",physical_host="$host"}))) and on(host) ((time() - max by(host)(igpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node"})) < 180)

panels.title: Attached GPU busy
panels.description: Driver-reported busy ratio; no invented Apple or Intel whole-device busy percentage.

targets.expr: (100 * max by(host,device)(gpu_utilization_ratio{job="node",host="$host"}) * on(host,device) group_left(physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name) label_replace(max by(host,physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name,telemetry)(node_monitoring_gpu_inventory_info{job="node",host="$host"}),"device","$1","physical_device","(.*)")) and on(host,device) (max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node",host="$host"}) == 1) and on(host,device) ((time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node",host="$host"})) < 180)

panels.title: Attached GPU temperature
panels.description: Only actual vendor temperature readings; absence stays unavailable.

targets.expr: (max by(host,device)(gpu_temperature_celsius{job="node",host="$host"}) * on(host,device) group_left(physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name) label_replace(max by(host,physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name,telemetry)(node_monitoring_gpu_inventory_info{job="node",host="$host"}),"device","$1","physical_device","(.*)")) and on(host,device) (max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node",host="$host"}) == 1) and on(host,device) ((time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node",host="$host"})) < 180)

panels.title: Attached GPU memory used
panels.description: Driver-reported visible GPU memory allocation, not total host RAM or a universal shared-memory limit.

targets.expr: (100 * max by(host,device)(gpu_memory_used_bytes{job="node",host="$host"}) / (max by(host,device)(gpu_memory_total_bytes{job="node",host="$host"}) > 0) * on(host,device) group_left(physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name) label_replace(max by(host,physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name,telemetry)(node_monitoring_gpu_inventory_info{job="node",host="$host"}),"device","$1","physical_device","(.*)")) and on(host,device) (max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node",host="$host"}) == 1) and on(host,device) ((time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node",host="$host"})) < 180)

panels.title: Attached GPU power
panels.description: Actual GPU power only; missing counters are unsupported, not idle zero.

targets.expr: (max by(host,device)(gpu_power_watts{job="node",host="$host"}) * on(host,device) group_left(physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name) label_replace(max by(host,physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name,telemetry)(node_monitoring_gpu_inventory_info{job="node",host="$host"}),"device","$1","physical_device","(.*)")) and on(host,device) (max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node",host="$host"}) == 1) and on(host,device) ((time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node",host="$host"})) < 180)

(time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node",host="$host"})) * on(host,device) group_left(physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name) label_replace(max by(host,physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name,telemetry)(node_monitoring_gpu_inventory_info{job="node",host="$host"}),"device","$1","physical_device","(.*)")

panels.title: Attached GPU adapter result
panels.description: Explicit native adapter status; unsupported Apple has no adapter and no invented status.

targets.expr: max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node",host="$host"})

panels.title: Reported desktop GPU memory capacity
panels.description: Vendor-reported visible GPU memory only; does not aggregate unlike dedicated and shared memory pools.

targets.expr: max by(host,device)(gpu_memory_total_bytes{job="node",host="$host"}) and on(host,device) (max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node",host="$host"}) == 1) and on(host,device) ((time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node",host="$host"})) < 180)
